reviews.title: Awful customer service
reviews.body:
1. email received from Lebara stating a new SIM ordered had been despatched.  This had not been ordered by me.
2. Immediately contacted Lebara.  They were unable to say where the SIM had been sent to.
3. Requested that new SIM be cancelled.  They assured me they had done this.
4. Following day discovered Lebara had cancelled my SIM rather than new one.  
5. Contacted Lebara insisting that they reactivate my SIM and cancel the new one.
6. SIM reactivated, and Lebara assured me only one active SIM was registered to my account, but now I am unsure if new SIM has been deactivated as Lebara assured me had been done.
7. Three days later I travelled overseas and purchased roaming package.
8. Unable to contact to local network so contacted Lebara using on line chat to find that my number had been ported out to another user following the issue of a PAC by Lebara.
9. Informed Lebara that I had not requested / authorised the PAC nor porting out, requested that they arrange for number to be frozen and returned to me.
10.  Spent much time and roaming minutes (purchased from Lebara using my wife's phone) to contact bank / credit card providers to flag potential fraud.
11.  Accounts had already been accessed using two stage authentication.  Providers demonstrated good customer service by freezing accounts and refunding fraudulent transactions.
12.  Numerous calls to Lebara to determine if they had traced the user / network my number had been ported to.
13  Each call basically said Lebara will call back in 24 hours.
14 Three weeks later I have had one call back which said they were investigating and would call back in 24 hours (they did not)
15. Back in the UK I make daily calls for an update, each time there is a refusal to let me speak to a manager / complaints team and I am told they will call back within 24 hours.
16.  After 18 days they finally identify the carrier where my number was ported to and supposedly made a request for it to be blocked and returned.
17.  I am told that the complaint has been closed because they tried to contact me and I failed to answer - they had called the ported out number!

18. While abroad used 127 roaming minutes and more time on on line chats, Lebara refused to credit me with the cost of sorting out the problem caused by them.

19. Problem is still not sorted, holiday severely blighted by stress, time spent trying to sort out Lebara's awful mistakes and subsequent total lack of care.

I have never come across a company which had so little care for its customers.
reviews.author: Ken Sanders
